title: Guided demo audio, interactive walkthrough and realistic targets
details: Demo audio evidence now records one real audio file with step-by-step prompts, matching the guided NVQ audio pattern
The demo evidence routes are now Practical evidence for Skills and Knowledge evidence for guided audio Knowledge evidence
The first-run walkthrough is now interactive, showing where to press and simulating the Evia evidence, coverage and Test journey
Ten-week apprenticeship targets are now paced against the learner's actual programme dates and contracted hours instead of asking for unrealistic early progress
Existing excessive target periods are automatically corrected when v217 opens
summary: Evia v217 makes the college demo more representative of the real evidence flow and recalibrates learner targets to achievable review-period progress.
changes: Added guided one-file demo audio with Next prompt timestamps
Mapped demo photo evidence to Skills only and demo audio evidence to Knowledge only
Paced KSB, evidence breadth, OTJ and EPA targets to the real course timeline
Based apprenticeship OTJ review targets on 20% of contracted weekly hours when those hours are available
Created a fresh v217 offline cache
